//: Standalone (does not extend tsconfig.base.json) so Next's required compilerOptions (jsx, next plugin, dom lib) stay isolated. Two path maps: '@/*' for app-internal imports, and '@meetcopilot/shared' pointing at package SOURCE so `tsc --noEmit` is green with no build ordering (shared/dist is gitignored/absent in M0). At runtime Next resolves the same package via transpilePackages + the workspace symlink.
